overview_description.description:
Crossing Minds is the smartest platform powering perceptive recommendations that drive online discovery and engagement. Founded and led by world-renowned AI pioneers and powered by the latest advances in deep learning, Crossing Minds instantly delivers precise, session-based recommendations that don’t infringe on or jeopardize customer privacy. 

We help businesses engage their customers.
We help people discover products they love.
We help turn curiosity into loyalty.

about_short_description.short_description: The smartest recommendation platform for your business.

product.name: Data Enrichment
product.description: Generates new, intuitive product metadata to improve search, recommendations, and filters by cleaning, deduplicating, and tagging product catalogs.

product.name: Personalized Recommendations
product.description: Provides AI-driven product recommendations tailored to individual user behavior and preferences to enhance product discovery and increase conversions.

product.name: Conversational Search
product.description: Enables natural language search experiences by interpreting user queries with AI to deliver relevant product or content results.

product.name: Real Time Retrieval Engine
product.description: A system that retrieves relevant items instantly using AI-powered algorithms to support dynamic recommendations and search results.

product.name: Gen-AI Fine Tuning
product.description: Customizes large language models using domain-specific data to improve recommendation and search accuracy for specific business needs.
